name: Apple Valley Farmers' Market
tagline: Pahl's Market Garden Center, Greenhouse, Nursery
description: Apple Valley Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 7100 147th St W, MN. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
